title: Microsoft Copilot: delegated publishing of organisation prompts

reasons: published before the check existed: kept live with a notice while a corrected version is prepared

summary: Hold: the scope section says cloud availability is unstated, but the roadmap explicitly lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant). The claim that prompt management is portal-only also goes beyond the documentation; the narrower statement that no automation route is documented is supported.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified on 12 November 2026 at 01:50:56.

claims.quote: Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups.

claims.quote: Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Delegated organisation prompt management operates at tenant level.
claims.quote: create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab

claims.claim: Delegates can manage prompts without accessing the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.claim: Administrators retain monitoring and oversight through the existing admin centre experience.
claims.quote: Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

claims.claim: Delegated publishing requires administrator configuration, represented as admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts

claims.claim: Administrators create, edit, import and pin organisation prompts at Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Prompts.
claims.quote: Expand Copilot and select Prompts. ... The following actions are available for prompts: ... Create prompt ... Edit ... Delete ... Export all prompts ... Import prompts ... Pin

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Current organisation prompt management uses the AI Administrator or Search Editor role.
claims.quote: To manage, create, update, edit, import, and delete organizational prompts, use one of the following roles, or a role with equivalent permissions: AI Administrator; Search Editor
claims.fix: Qualify the current-role statement and control note with 'or a role with equivalent permissions', as the cited prerequisites do.

claims.claim: A tenant can publish up to 1,000 organisation prompts.
claims.quote: You can publish up to 1,000 organizational prompts in your tenant.

claims.claim: No Graph, PowerShell or other automation equivalent for organisation prompt management is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "Graph" "PowerShell"' and '"organizational prompts" "API"'; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/organizational-prompts. No equivalent found for this prompt library.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has not documented the UI or API control for the planned publishing delegation.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "delegation"', '"organizational prompts" "delegated"', '"organizational prompts" "API"'; opened Learn /copilot/manage/organizational-prompts and /copilot/implement/configure-copilot-admin-center. No delegation control found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Licensing specific to delegated prompt publishers has not been published, so the model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "delegates" "license"' and '"organizational prompts" "licensing"'; opened organizational-prompts and copilot/microsoft-365/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing on Learn. Neither specifies a delegated-publisher licence.

claims.claim: No licence or pricing change specific to delegated publishing has been published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" license pricing', '"organizational prompts" "licensing"'; opened Learn /copilot/manage/organizational-prompts and /copilot/microsoft-365/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing. No delegation-specific charge or licence change found.

claims.claim: Organisation prompts are displayed in Microsoft Copilot Chat, Microsoft Edge and Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: When the prompts are published, they're displayed to users in Microsoft Copilot Chat, Microsoft Edge, and Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Cloud availability is not stated in the material reviewed.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]
claims.fix: Replace the scope sentence with 'The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).' Do not infer exclusion of clouds the record does not list.

claims.claim: Selecting an organisation prompt puts it in the chat box without submitting it automatically.
claims.quote: Selecting a prompt places the prompt into the Copilot Chat message box but doesn't submit it. Users can modify the prompt easily before they submit it.

claims.claim: Administrators can pin up to four organisation prompts.
claims.quote: You can pin up to four prompts.

claims.claim: Prompt analytics include active users.
claims.quote: Active users: The number of distinct users who use this prompt.

claims.claim: Prompt analytics include submission counts.
claims.quote: Submissions: The total number of times the prompt is submitted to Copilot.

claims.claim: Prompt management is portal-only.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "API"', '"organizational prompts" "Graph" "PowerShell"'; opened Learn /copilot/manage/organizational-prompts and /copilot/implement/configure-copilot-admin-center. Neither states portal management is the only possible route.
claims.fix: Replace 'Prompt management is portal-only and role-gated' with 'Microsoft Learn documents role-gated prompt management in the admin centre; no Graph or PowerShell equivalent is documented at the time of writing (November 2026).'

claims.claim: Search Editor is a less privileged publishing option than AI Administrator.
claims.quote: Search Editor: Users in this role can create, manage, and delete content for Microsoft Search ... AI Administrator: This is a privileged role ... Manage all aspects of Microsoft Copilot
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference#search-editor and #ai-administrator for the role-scope comparison; the linked Configure Copilot settings page does not make that comparison.

claims.claim: Whether publishing delegation itself is audited has not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organization prompts" delegated publishing audit pin' and '"organizational prompts" "audit"'; opened learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/organizational-prompts. Purview results describe scheduled prompts, not publishing delegation.

claims.claim: Whether delegates can pin prompts is unstated.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organization prompts" delegated publishing audit pin'; opened learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/organizational-prompts. Its pinning instructions cover administrators, not the planned delegates; the roadmap lists create, edit and delete only.

claims.claim: Purview audit logging for delegated organisation prompt edits is unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "audit"', '"organization prompts" delegated publishing audit pin'; opened https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/organizational-prompts. No documentation of Purview events for delegated library edits found.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells administrators to review prompt analytics, but the controls table has no analytics row.
claims.quote: After rollout: 'Review prompt analytics for active users and submissions.' Controls rows: 'Creating, editing, importing and pinning organisation prompts'; 'Delegating prompt publishing to other roles or people'.
claims.fix: Add a 'Reviewing organisation prompt analytics' control row. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/organizational-prompts#review-analytics-for-organizational-prompts; use the documented Copilot > Prompts management location and note Active users and Submissions.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating conflicts with the standard for an optional administrator-configured capability.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; defaultState: "admin-opt-in"; 'admins can grant prompt publishing to individual users, Microsoft Entra security groups and distribution groups.'
claims.fix: Change action to 'review': this is an optional new delegation control, no source says existing publishing behaviour changes without administrator action, and the briefing does not rate the remaining exposure high.

controlChecks.governs: Creating, editing, importing and pinning organisation prompts
